tasks.description: Stand up from the specified supported starting posture and hold a stable upright stance.
Sit down from a stable standing posture and hold the supported sitting posture without falling.
Maintain a stable upright stance at the current location for the requested interval.
Move forward in the robot's initial heading direction, then stop in a stable upright stance.
Adjust the robot body to the specified target height and hold it upright at the current location.
